title_sq: PENTHOUSE 3+1+2 ME VERANDE + POST PARKIMI, LIQENI I THATE!!!

title_en: PENTHOUSE 3+1+2 WITH VERANDA + PARKING POST, DRY LAKE!!!

This penthouse is fully invested and coherently furnished. - Total area: 303.2 m² of property. - Internal surface: 142.2 m², with natural lighting. - Porch: 161 m², surrounded by greenery. - Organization: - Large and bright living room with open kitchen. - 3 spacious bedrooms. - 2 good invested toilets. - Personal garage included in the price. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
